options.name: Far Shot
options.benefit: Reduce range increment penalties with ranged weapons.

options.name: Point-Blank Shot
options.benefit: Gain +1 on ranged attack and damage rolls within 30 feet.

options.name: Precise Shot
options.benefit: Ignore the penalty for firing into melee.

options.name: Rapid Shot
options.benefit: Make one additional ranged attack during a full attack at a penalty.

options.name: Improved Precise Shot
options.benefit: Ignore most cover and concealment with ranged attacks.

options.name: Manyshot
options.benefit: Fire two arrows with the first attack of a bow full attack.

options.name: Pinpoint Targeting
options.benefit: Make one ranged attack that ignores armor, natural armor, and shield bonuses.

options.name: Shot on the Run
options.benefit: Make a ranged attack during movement.

options.name: Double Slice
options.benefit: Add full Strength bonus to off-hand weapon damage.

options.name: Improved Shield Bash
options.benefit: Retain shield AC when making a shield bash.

options.name: Quick Draw
options.benefit: Draw weapons as a free action.

options.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.benefit: Reduce penalties for fighting with two weapons.

options.name: Two-Weapon Defense
options.benefit: Gain a shield bonus while wielding two weapons.

options.name: Two-Weapon Rend
options.benefit: Deal extra damage after hitting with both weapons.
